# Welltroy

Welltroy is a B2B packaging contact based in Shenzhen, China. Its current catalogue covers poly mailers, biodegradable mailers, bubble mailers, zipper bags, paper bags, stand-up pouches, thermal labels and honeycomb paper rolls.

Official website: https://welltroy.com/
Company: Shenzhen Welltroy Technology Co., Ltd.
Email: info@welltroy.com

Important pages:
- Product catalogue: https://welltroy.com/products/
- Packaging by industry: https://welltroy.com/industries/
- Buying process: https://welltroy.com/why-welltroy/
- Mailer selection guide: https://welltroy.com/guides/choose-a-mailer/
- Buyer FAQ: https://welltroy.com/faq/
- Selected buyer reviews: https://welltroy.com/reviews/
- Request a quote: https://welltroy.com/quote/

Catalogue dimensions are starting points. Product-specific material, MOQ, production timing, compliance and shipping terms should be confirmed for each order.
The website includes 10 catalogue ranges and 8 new product listings. For eligible bag and mailer specifications, the starting MOQ is 500 pieces; honeycomb paper starts at 500 rolls. Confirm the sales unit for thermal labels. A free initial design draft is offered within 24 hours after a clear brief. Samples are free. Preparation can take as little as 3 days after specifications and artwork are confirmed, with a delivery target within 7 days of confirmation depending on destination. Confirm the sample type and shipping arrangements, including any delivery charges, before dispatch. Bulk production is approximately 15–20 days after payment. T/T (bank transfer / wire transfer) is accepted.
